title: 第一卷 风起时 第十七章 孔瑶欲杀兄第一卷 风起时 第十八章 小逸的逆天异术

陈风奇站在应劫龟甲之上，居高临下，俯视着远方忽然闯入的三人。
这三人气喘吁吁，青丝凌乱，显得极其狼狈，且在其中两人的身上，都有伤的样子。
这让陈风奇微微眯眼，猜测他们多半不是因为夜幕降临才会如此狼狈，极有可能是前不久刚经历过一场大战。
他的目光，更多汇聚在孔瑶身上。
三人中也只有她，看上去没有受伤。
她是一位身段极好，样貌极美的女子，看上去清清冷冷的，在气质上有点像谢禾，却又不及谢禾清冷。
陈风奇曾向图灵了解过这位兵冢山的二把手，据说是山主的相好，又有传闻说是山主的嫡亲妹妹。
至于到底哪个是真的，图灵就不知道了。
他们这些人虽然依附兵冢山，可对于兵冢山的了解，却不算太多。
此刻，孔瑶同样注视着应劫龟甲上的两人。
待她看到趴在陈风奇脚下，全身烧伤的图灵时，眼中出现了一抹惊讶。
当她再看陈风奇时，眼中又出现饶有兴趣之色。
但在她的身后，像是她手下的一男一女，却是蹙起了眉头。
龟甲村作为兵冢山的附庸村，而图灵又是龟甲村的首领，他们当然认识。
可现在的图灵，却重伤无力地趴在另一个人的脚下，明显是被挟持了。
“你是什么人？”
孔瑶身旁的一位男子站了出来，厉声喝道。
陈风奇不动声色，并没有回答。
那男子神色一冷，又上前一步，道：“你好大的胆子，知不知道这里是什么地方？敢动我兵冢山的人？”

“兵冢山？”
陈风奇总算开口了，却故作疑惑，“抱歉，没听过。不过你既然说他是你们的人，那就还给你们好了。”
话落，他抬脚一踹，直接将脚下的图灵朝几人踹了出去。
这看似轻轻的一脚，却着实不轻，蕴含了陈风奇的担山之力，将图灵都给踹出了一道残影，似一块速度飞快的石头，直直砸向了那位叫嚣男子。
男子大惊失色，本能想要抬手去接，可手才刚刚触碰到图灵，立刻感受到了一股不可抗拒之力传来。
随着“轰”一声巨响，男子整个人已经被砸到在地，更在地上砸出了一个坑。
尽管这男子修为不俗，至少在凝气五层，可因为前不久受过伤，还是被这一下砸得嘴角溢血。
至于他身上的图灵，已经彻底没了气息。
陈风奇漠然看着这一幕，他其实已经忍图灵很久了。
同时也早就看出来，对方之所以带他来龟甲村，就是想让他去修行那第一古术。
如果不是他当初有读剑经导致自身昏迷的经历，说不得还真就会不自量力去修行第一古术，终而着了图灵的道。
之所以留他到现在，不过是想知道更多关于兵冢山的事。
如今既然有兵冢山的人到来，他也就不需要图灵了。
不过让陈风奇感到遗憾的是，来的是兵冢山的二把手，而不是三把手。
以陈风骨那件事来说，图灵绝对是主谋，陈风奇不可能放过他。
而那些参与围杀的人，则是帮凶，陈风奇同样不会放过。
尤其是兵冢山的三把手，更是导致陈风骨重伤的元凶，已经进了陈风奇的必杀名单。

Chen Fengqi stood on top of the tortoise shell, looking down at the three people who suddenly broke in from afar.
The three of them were panting, their hair was messy, and they looked extremely embarrassed, and two of them looked injured.
This made Chen Fengqi squint his eyes slightly, guessing that they were probably not in such a mess because of nightfall, but most likely because they had just experienced a big battle not long ago.
His eyes focused more on Kong Yao.
She was the only one among the three who looked uninjured.
She is a woman with an excellent figure and beautiful appearance. She looks cold and cold. She is a bit like Xie He in temperament, but not as cold as Xie He.
Chen Fengqi once learned from Turing about the second-in-command of Bingzhong Mountain. It is said that she is the mountain owner's best friend, and there are also rumors that she is the mountain owner's biological sister.
As for which one is true, Turing doesn't know.
Although these people are attached to Bingzhong Mountain, they don't know much about Bingzhong Mountain.
At this moment, Kong Yao was also looking at the two people on Ying Jie's tortoise shell.
When she saw Turing lying at Chen Fengqi's feet with burns all over his body, a look of surprise appeared in her eyes.
When she looked at Chen Fengqi again, interest appeared in her eyes again.
But behind her, a man and a woman who looked like her subordinates frowned.
Turtle Village is a vassal village of Bingzhong Mountain, and Turing is the leader of Turtle Village, so of course they know each other.
But now Turing was seriously injured and lying weakly at the feet of another person, obviously being held hostage.
"Who are you?"
A man next to Kong Yao stood up and shouted sharply.
Chen Fengqi remained calm and did not answer.
The man's expression turned cold, and he took another step forward and said, "You are so brave. Do you know where this place is? You dare to touch the people of Bingzhong Mountain?"
"Hyozhong Mountain?"
Chen Fengqi finally spoke, but he pretended to be confused, "Sorry, I haven't heard of him. But since you said he is one of yours, I'll give it back to you."
After saying this, he raised his foot and kicked Turing directly under his feet towards several people.
This seemed to be a light kick, but it was actually not light. It contained Chen Fengqi's mountain-bearing power, and it kicked Turing into an afterimage, like a fast stone, hitting the yelling man directly.
The man was shocked, and instinctively wanted to raise his hand to pick it up, but as soon as his hand touched Turing, he immediately felt an irresistible force.
With a loud "boom", the man was knocked to the ground, and a hole was made in the ground.
Although this man had a good level of cultivation, at least at the fifth level of Qi Condensation, he was still hit with blood from the corner of his mouth because he had been injured not long ago.
As for the Turing on him, he had completely lost his breath.
Chen Fengqi looked at this scene indifferently. He had actually been enduring Turing for a long time.
At the same time, he had already seen that the reason why the other party brought him to Turtle Armor Village was because he wanted him to practice the first ancient art.
If he hadn't had the experience of being in a coma after reading the Sword Scripture, he would probably have overestimated his ability to practice the first ancient art, and finally followed Turing's path.
The reason why I have kept him here till now is just because I want to know more about Hyozuka Mountain.
Now that someone from Bingzhong Mountain has arrived, he doesn't need Turing anymore.
But what made Chen Fengqi regretful was that it was the second-in-command from Bingzhong Mountain who came, not the third-in-command.
In the case of Chen Fenggu, Turing was definitely the mastermind, and there was no way Chen Fengqi would let him go.
Those who participated in the siege and killing were accomplices, and Chen Fengqi would not let them go either.
Especially the third in command of Bingzhong Mountain, the culprit who caused Chen Fenggu to be seriously injured, has been on Chen Fengqi's must-kill list.
